verdict.rationale: Jina Reader fetches web pages for users, so honoring robots.txt and per-site rate limits is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence documents robots.txt compliance or automatic per-target throttling. The closest items are adjacent: a 5-minute cache, S3 page caching, and a proxy pool that rotates IPs and handles anti-bot challenges, none of which is the requested capability.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can configure the crawler to respect robots.txt rules and target-site rate limits automatically
